basic_info.description: Very modern 1-bed loft with high ceilings and an entrance right off the lush secure courtyard.  Inside you are greeted with a very spacious living kitchen and dining room.  An architectural spiral staircase takes you up to the bedroom loft.  A chef inspired kitchen with premium appliances, floors throughout, recessed lighting on dimmers, 20 wall-surround tiles lining the sunken tub, and an abundance of sunlight that makes this home unique to any other. 1288 Howard offers superior amenities: A 7-day a week lobby attendant, a state-of-the-art fitness center, business center, rooftop terrace with BBQ, firepits & TV, a garden courtyard, and ample bike storage while keeping HOA dues low. With its distinctive Lane, a contemporary interpretation of a European Cobblestone alley, 1288 Howard is an urban sanctuary. After enjoying the city's top restaurants, theater & entertainment.
